decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning Statement prepared by Savills (dated March 2016), Design and Access Statement prepared by Lifschutz Davidson Sandilands (0902A doc 009, dated March 2016). Received on 15 March 2016. X0001, X0010, X0011, X0101, X0102, X0103, X0105, X0151, X0152, P0010, P0011, P0102, P0103, P0104, P0151, P0152, P0153, P0154, P0171, P0172, P0173, P0174, P0175. Received on 27 April 2016. P0001 Rev. B, P0101 Rev. B, P0176. Received on 06 May 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before any plant and/or machinery is used on the premises, it shall be designed and mounted in a way which will generate a noise level that is at least 10dB below the background noise levels, in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall not be eligible for on-street parking permits for Business and Shared Use permit bays. This would not affect residents parking bays.
description: Creation of new entrance and associated windows in western elevation, enclosure of existing undercroft and rear courtyard to create additional ground floor office accommodation (Use Class B1), and other works including parking, refuse storage and plant.
